title: CSBC Bihar Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026
organization: Central Selection Board of Constable, Bihar
postName: Police Driver – Driver Eligibility Test (DET) Admit Card
vacancyDetails: Admit card for Bihar Police Driver DET
qualification: As per CSBC Driver notification; valid driving licence as required
ageLimit: As per CSBC Bihar Police Driver rules
selectionProcess: Written / as notified → DET → Physical / DV stages
documentsRequired: Registration number, DOB; printed admit card, photo ID, driving licence for DET
howToApply:
1. Visit https://csbc.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Driver DET Admit Card link
3. Login with registration credentials

shortDescription: CSBC Bihar Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026. Download from csbc.bihar.gov.in.
content:
CSBC Bihar has released the Police Driver DET Admit Card 2026.

Candidates must download the hall ticket and appear for the Driver Eligibility Test with original licence and photo ID as instructed.
